name: IC Microcontroller — 1.32V — BGA
description: This cluster includes surface-mount microcontroller ICs with a 1.32V supply rating in BGA packaging.
selection_hints: Select for microcontroller applications requiring a 1.32V supply voltage.
Use when board layouts require SMD BGA footprints such as TFBGA-196.
Check part specifications and symbol definitions for ATSAMA5D21 components.
avoid_when: Do not use when operating voltages other than 1.32V are required.
Avoid if through-hole or non-BGA packages are needed for the PCB layout.
Avoid if Tier A verified library entries are strictly required.
